list Ctrl-y.why: Scrolling the 3,000-message list up a line costs the app p99 64-76 ms when the page does it itself (control row, three runs; p50 24-28 ms); the plugin's key adds no script time to that.

thread j.why: Over 50 ms in one of four runs (53-140 ms across the attempts of that run, 39-50 ms in the others). The thread pane of the harness is slow to scroll and to focus whatever does it: the page's own scroll down a line is p99 40-83 ms (control row), a jump 98-175 ms, a focus move 41-111 ms. The plugin's script is about 5 ms of the key's 23-26.

thread k.why: The weakest entry. Over 50 ms in two of three runs (56-110 ms); the page's own scroll up a line is p99 33-64 ms (control row), and the plugin's script is about 5 ms of the key's 20-24. The rest is the page scrolling the row into view.

thread h.why: Moving the focus between the thread and the channel costs the app p50 23-25 ms and p99 49-111 ms when the page does it itself (control row, three runs): style recalculation of about 8 ms in a pane with 80 replies. The key costs the same.

thread l.why: The same focus move as `h`, in the other direction (control row: p50 22-23 ms, p99 41-53 ms).

thread gg.why: Jumping to the top of the 80-reply thread costs the app p50 38-46 ms and p99 98-175 ms when the page does it itself (control row, three runs).

thread G.why: Jumping to the bottom of the 80-reply thread costs the app p50 42-50 ms and p99 105-147 ms when the page does it itself (control row, three runs).

settings l: open the next section.why: The host renders a whole settings section anew on every click: p50 115-127 ms, p99 139-196 ms when the page clicks the open section itself (control row, three runs). The row presses h, j and l, so it carries two more key presses.

settings l: open the section before.why: The same as the next section: the host renders a whole settings section anew on every click (control row: p50 115-127 ms, p99 139-196 ms). The row presses h, k and l.
